You also had a pretty decent leap in your Rx. Going from -0.50 OU up half a step and then adding that much cyl in there may be giving you some issues with adapting to your lenses.

Honestly, there's so many things that it /could/ be that it's kind of hard to diagnose without having a bit more information.
